name: Sage Intacct
description: Connect your own Sage Intacct company (OAuth2) to manage customers, vendors, employees, AR invoices, AP bills, payments, GL accounts, journal entries, departments, entities, projects, items and tax details -- full read/write plus value-add cash position and overdue-invoice reports.

tools.name: connect_sage_intacct
tools.description: Start connecting your Sage Intacct company: register your Sage Intacct app's Client ID/Client Secret, then get back a one-time browser authorize_url. Open it, sign in with Sage Intacct, and approve access -- Sage Intacct redirects back here automatically and the connection finishes itself. Important: you must also separately authorize this app as a client application inside your Sage Intacct company (Company > Setup > Configuration > Authorized client applications) for calls to succeed.

client_id.description: Your Sage Intacct app's Client ID (developer.sage.com/intacct).
client_id.title: Client Id

client_secret.description: Your Sage Intacct app's Client Secret.
client_secret.title: Client Secret

label.description: Optional friendly label for this connection, e.g. 'Acme US entity'.
label.title: Label

authorize_url.description: Open this URL in a browser to sign in with Sage Intacct and approve access. Remember to also authorize this app as a client application inside your Sage Intacct company (Company > Setup > Configuration).
authorize_url.title: Authorize Url

redirect_uri.description: The callback URL registered for this attempt (must match a Redirect URI configured on your Sage Intacct app).
redirect_uri.title: Redirect Uri

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List the connected Sage Intacct companies.

params_schema.description: Explicit empty params model -- V17 disallows untyped handlers.
params_schema.title: NoParams

tools.name: disconnect_sage_intacct
tools.description: Disconnect a Sage Intacct connection: deletes the saved connection. Nothing in Sage Intacct itself is changed.

connection_id.description: Which connection to disconnect (see list_connections). Omit if only one exists.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_entities
tools.description: List Sage Intacct records of any object type (customer, vendor, employee, ar-invoice, ap-bill, ap-payment, ar-payment, general-ledger-account, journal-entry, journal, department, location, project, item, tax-detail), with an optional filter.

connection_id.description: Which connected Sage Intacct company to use (see list_connections). Omit if only one company is connected.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

entity_id.description: Which child entity to target, for multi-entity companies. Omit to use the connection's default entity.
entity_id.title: Entity Id

filter_json.description: Optional Sage Intacct REST v1 filter object as a JSON string, e.g. '{"$eq":{"status":"active"}}'.
filter_json.title: Filter Json

limit.description: Max records to return (Sage Intacct default page size applies if omitted).
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: Read one Sage Intacct record of any object type in full by its key.

connection_id.description: Which connected Sage Intacct company to use (see list_connections). Omit if only one company is connected.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

entity_id.description: Which child entity to target, for multi-entity companies. Omit to use the connection's default entity.
entity_id.title: Entity Id

entity_key.description: The record's key (Sage Intacct's own record 'key' field, not always the human-readable id).
entity_key.title: Entity Key

tools.name: create_entity
tools.description: Create a new Sage Intacct record of any object type from a JSON object of its fields exactly as Sage Intacct expects.

connection_id.description: Which connected Sage Intacct company to use (see list_connections). Omit if only one company is connected.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

entity_id.description: Which child entity to target, for multi-entity companies. Omit to use the connection's default entity.
entity_id.title: Entity Id

entity.description: Sage Intacct object name to create, e.g. 'customer', 'ar-invoice'.
entity.title: Entity

fields_json.description: JSON object of the new record's fields exactly as Sage Intacct expects.
fields_json.title: Fields Json

tools.name: update_entity
tools.description: Update selected fields of an existing Sage Intacct record. Only the fields in fields_json change.

connection_id.description: Which connected Sage Intacct company to use (see list_connections). Omit if only one company is connected.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

entity_id.description: Which child entity to target, for multi-entity companies. Omit to use the connection's default entity.
entity_id.title: Entity Id

entity.description: Sage Intacct object name to update.
entity.title: Entity

fields_json.description: JSON object of only the fields to change.
fields_json.title: Fields Json

tools.name: delete_entity
tools.description: Delete a Sage Intacct record of any object type by its key. Cannot be undone.

connection_id.description: Which connected Sage Intacct company to use (see list_connections). Omit if only one company is connected.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

entity_id.description: Which child entity to target, for multi-entity companies. Omit to use the connection's default entity.
entity_id.title: Entity Id

entity.description: Sage Intacct object name to delete from.
entity.title: Entity

tools.name: run_query
tools.description: Run a flexible query against any Sage Intacct object with optional filter/field projection/order-by/limit -- the most flexible way to filter, sort, or project any Sage Intacct data.

connection_id.description: Which connected Sage Intacct company to use (see list_connections). Omit if only one company is connected.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

entity_id.description: Which child entity to target, for multi-entity companies. Omit to use the connection's default entity.
entity_id.title: Entity Id

entity.description: Sage Intacct object name to query.
entity.title: Entity

filter_json.description: Optional filter object as JSON string.
filter_json.title: Filter Json

fields_json.description: Optional JSON array of field names to project, e.g. '["key","customername","balance"]'. Omit for all fields.
fields_json.title: Fields Json

order_by_json.description: Optional JSON array of order-by objects, e.g. '[{"customername":"asc"}]'.
order_by_json.title: Order By Json

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Read the connected Sage Intacct company's own profile: company id, name, base currency, and its child entities.

connection_id.description: Which connected Sage Intacct company to use (see list_connections). Omit if only one company is connected.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

entity_id.description: Which child entity to target, for multi-entity companies. Omit to use the connection's default entity.
entity_id.title: Entity Id

tools.name: get_cash_position
tools.description: Value-add report: one-glance cash position for the connected Sage Intacct company -- bank account balances plus total open AR and AP, computed by scanning ar-invoice/ap-bill open balances.

connection_id.description: Which connected Sage Intacct company to use (see list_connections). Omit if only one company is connected.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

entity_id.description: Which child entity to target, for multi-entity companies. Omit to use the connection's default entity.
entity_id.title: Entity Id

tools.name: get_overdue_invoices
tools.description: Value-add report: flag every AR invoice overdue by at least a given number of days.

connection_id.description: Which connected Sage Intacct company to use (see list_connections). Omit if only one company is connected.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

entity_id.description: Which child entity to target, for multi-entity companies. Omit to use the connection's default entity.
entity_id.title: Entity Id

min_days_overdue.description: Only include invoices overdue by at least this many days.
min_days_overdue.title: Min Days Overdue

secrets.name: sage_intacct_connections
secrets.description: JSON array of connected Sage Intacct OAuth grants: client_id/client_secret (your own Sage Intacct app), access_token, refresh_token, expiry timestamps, default_entity_id, and label. Managed through connect_sage_intacct / disconnect_sage_intacct -- you should not need to edit this directly.

secrets.name: sage_intacct_pending
secrets.description: JSON array of in-flight Sage Intacct OAuth connection attempts (client_id/client_secret captured at connect_sage_intacct time, keyed by a pending id used as the OAuth `state`), consumed and removed by the callback webhook once the code-for-token exchange completes. write_mode='extension': only connector code writes this, never the Panel UI directly.
